semantics.exact_statement: Under the conventions and assumptions imported from PR-411: (1) a vector fixed by the standard infinitesimal SO(3) generators is zero, and a real symmetric trace-free 3 by 3 tensor commuting with all three generators is zero; (2) using the exact normalized sphere moments integral n_i n_j dOmega = 4 pi delta_ij/3 and integral n_i n_j n_k n_l dOmega = 4 pi(delta_ij delta_kl + delta_ik delta_jl + delta_il delta_jk)/15, the registered dipole and STF2 integrals reconstruct v and S from q(n)=v dot n + S_ij n_i n_j with tr(S)=0; (3) a fixed positive scalar anchor is an invertible rescaling, so the registered Fisher matrix obeys F_D=D^T F D and rank is unchanged; (4) for symmetric K=[[k11,k12],[k12,k22]] and diagonal directional metric diag(p,q,r), det(K tensor S)=det(K)^3 det(S)^2, while a one-shell depth Gram matrix has determinant zero; (5) the observation-inclusive finite-rank counting formula and conservative-tie inequality hold for m=1 through 100 at alpha=1/20; and (6) the registered antipodal weighted-axis construction has zero mean and diagonal second moment.

symbol_type_domain_map.Jx,Jy,Jz: standard real 3 by 3 infinitesimal rotation generators
symbol_type_domain_map.n: unit direction on S2 with rotation-invariant area measure dOmega
symbol_type_domain_map.D: invertible real parameter normalizer; the fixed scalar-anchor case is D=c I with c>0
symbol_type_domain_map.K: real symmetric 2 by 2 depth Gram matrix

frame_signature_units_conventions.rotation_action: active right-handed Cartesian SO(3) action; O(3) no-go follows because SO(3) is a subgroup
frame_signature_units_conventions.sphere_measure: integral over S2 has total area 4 pi
frame_signature_units_conventions.MES_anchor: fixed positive scale only; row-dependent self-anchors are excluded from this theorem
frame_signature_units_conventions.local_global_ordering: two depth profiles tensor three directional components

assumptions: all symbolic equalities are exact over the reals or rationals as declared
the sphere second- and fourth-moment identities are available to proof-assistant axes as explicit hypotheses if native integration libraries are not used
the tensor in the directional reconstruction is symmetric and trace free
the parameter normalizer D is invertible when rank invariance is asserted
finite ranks include the observation and all m null rows
the antipodal construction uses paired support at plus and minus each Cartesian basis vector
positivity_nonzero_conditions: det(D) is nonzero for rank invariance
exclusions: No scalar-to-direction or scalar-to-STF construction is permitted.
No row-dependent self-anchor is treated as an invertible fixed reparameterization.
No masked or discrete quadrature is certified by the full-sky identity.
No physical local/global response, native solver result, family identification, posterior evidence, or release claim follows from this algebraic bundle.
The larger LOCAL-XACT, LOCAL-SAGE, LOCAL-LEAN reverse-martingale, and LOCAL-ROCQ tasks remain separately typed and are not silently discharged by this contract.
singular_loci: U=0 or det(D)=0 invalidates fixed-anchor rank invariance
repeated tensor eigenvalues make an eigenframe direction non-unique even though the scaled tensor identity remains valid
det(K)=0 or det(S)=0 makes the six-parameter Fisher matrix singular

target.canonical_form: The eleven named checks must all reduce exactly to true under the shared assumptions, with no assumption differences and no counterexample.
target.equivalence_relation: exact polynomial, rational, linear-algebraic, or finite-enumeration equality under the declared domains
invariants: zero fixed subspace in vector and STF2 representations
registered l=1 and l=2 moment normalization
Fisher congruence and rank under invertible fixed scaling
Kronecker determinant and single-shell rank obstruction
antipodal zero mean and second moment
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not read another axis script, derivation, transcript, or result before submitting.
Do not assume an obligation's conclusion as a rewrite hypothesis.
Do not treat tool preflight as claim validation.
Do not replace a missing engine, package, or proof with a pass or computation-class exception.
Do not weaken the directional reconstruction by silently dropping the registered normalization.
Do not infer a physical direction, family identity, or local/global discrimination from this contract.

wolfram_xact.obligation: Independently replay all eleven exact checks in Wolfram Language with xAct loaded; additionally replay the imported Wolfram oracle unchanged.

sympy.obligation: Independent exact SymPy derivation of all eleven registered checks, using explicit sphere moment tensors rather than numerical quadrature.

sage_singular.obligation: Independent exact SageMath derivation of all eleven checks with Singular version recorded and polynomial obligations checked over exact rings.

lean.obligation: Mathlib-backed exact formalization of all eleven checks; sphere reconstruction may consume only the two explicitly declared normalized sphere-moment identities as hypotheses.

permitted_inputs: the assigned axis artifact directory only
independence.script_result_ownership: per-axis until all blind results are complete; the main writer may then promote exact artifacts into portable evidence
independence.correlation_disclosure: All axes are coordinated by one main agent but use independent agents and independent engines; this is disclosed and does not turn engine agreement into scientific authority.

exceptions_adjudication.aggregate_status_rule: R3 requires CAS_4AXIS_PASS under one contract hash; majority vote is forbidden
